question: Should the main Control UI sidebar permanently adopt the exception-only connection-state policy—quiet while connected and visibly offline only after a two-second sustained disconnect?
rationale: The implementation is coherent and evidenced, but this PR deliberately changes a visible status-information policy rather than repairing a clearly broken contract; the protected maintainer signal reserves that UX choice for a human owner.

options.title: Approve exception-only status
options.body: Confirm the quiet connected state and delayed offline treatment as the intended sidebar policy, then merge after normal head/check gating.

options.title: Retain persistent status
options.body: Keep an always-visible connection indicator and request a narrowed redesign that preserves the existing continuous-status affordance.

recommendation.title: Approve exception-only status
recommendation.body: Confirm the quiet connected state and delayed offline treatment as the intended sidebar policy, then merge after normal head/check gating.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged work and this branch both cover the affected sidebar UI surface.
